stories.title: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts on IR due to blood clot, expected to be out indefinitely
stories.summary: The Eagles have decided to place Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.
stories.detail: The Philadelphia Eagles have decided to place Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts that continued into Saturday, sources told ESPN and NFL Network. The move will sideline the star quarterback indefinitely, according to sources. The Eagles, who officially announced the move Saturday afternoon, were waiting to make a roster decision until after consulting with medical experts, according to sources. Ever since Hurts started dealing with the superficial blood clot in his calf, the Eagles have been attempting to explore every option and gather as much information as possible. Hurts has met with doctors and had others review his blood clot and weigh in with their knowledge. At some time over the past 24 hours, additional information surfaced that made Philadelphia believe the wisest course of action was to place Hurts on IR, giving him the time he needs to heal. The Eagles maintained all along that they weren't going to rush into any decisions about Hurts' future, which is why they waited until Thursday to rule out the three-time Pro Bowler for Sunday's home game against the Carolina Panthers . Hurts now will miss games against the Panther…

stories.title: Cowboys need to approach the next two games as must wins
stories.summary: The next two weeks are huge for the Cowboys.
stories.detail: Amanda McCoy/Fort Worth Star-Telegram/Tribune News Service via Getty Images There are currently some very frustrating vibes surrounding the Dallas Cowboys. Through the first fives games, they’ve alternated wins and losses, which is the epitome of an average football team. When they lost to the 0-4 Tampa Bay Buccaneers, it wasn’t that they didn’t win, it was how poorly they looked while doing it. Their defense made undrafted free agent rookie quarterback Jalon Daniels look like a seasoned pro, and their offense, which is usually what they can fall back on, scored just 16 points. It’s been a display of inconsistency by the Cowboys so far this season. One thing that’s in their favor in terms of having a shot at the playoffs is that the NFC East, or NFC Least as its been nicknamed, is still more than winnable. The New York Giants lead the division at 3-1-1. Behind them are the Philadelphia Eagles and the Cowboys at 2-3, and the Washington Commanders are 1-3-1. Dallas has the Green Bay Packers on their slate for Sunday Night Football in Week 6 followed by the Eagles on Monday Night Football in Week 7. stories.summary: Lions defensive end DJ Wonnum could face a suspension if he commits two more penalties.
stories.detail: Oct 11, 2026; Glendale, Arizona, USA; Arizona Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett (7) reacts after a play against Detroit Lions defensive end DJ Wonnum (98) during the second quarter at State Farm Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Mark J. Rebilas-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Last week, Detroit Lions linebacker Jack Campbell received a $15,930 fine for a hip- drop tackle against the Carolina Panthers. This week, it was DJ Wonnum who was fined for the same infraction, costing him $12,611 out of his paycheck. As we explained in the story about Campbell’s penalty, there’s more concern than just a fine for players who committed a hip-drop tackle. A hip-drop tackle is one of five fouls that are considered “major,” and would result in a one-game fine if repeated a total of three times, per an NFL rule that was implemented this year. The other fouls that fall under this category are horse collar tackle, launching, hit on a defenseless player, and a blindside block. Here’s the wording of the new NFL rule . stories.title: Reports: Caleb Williams to start for Bears Sunday
stories.summary: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams was coy about his availability for Sunday's game against the Falcons during a Friday press conference, but he seemed to send a message with a social media post later in the day.
stories.detail: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams was coy about his availability for Sunday's game against the Falcons during a Friday press conference, but he seemed to send a message with a social media post later in the day. Williams posted a video that strongly suggested he would be returning from the hamstring injury that caused him to miss the last three weeks and multiple reports on Saturday afternoon confirm that is the case. Williams is set to start for the 3-2 Bears against the 2-3 Falcons. Williams was a full participant in practice all week, but the Bears listed him as questionable on Friday. The Bears won the first two games that Williams missed, but they struggled with Tyson Bagent at quarterback in last Sunday's loss to the Packers.

stories.title: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts placed on IR, will miss the Week 9 Giants game
stories.summary: The Eagles will be without QB Jalen Hurts when they play the NY Giants in Week 9
stories.detail: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The Philadelphia Eagles have placed quarterback Jalen Hurts on the injured reserve. Hurts will now be out for the next four weeks, and his earliest possible return is after the New York Giants travel to Philly to take on the Eagles in Week 9. While Hurts will be eligible to return following the Eagles’ Week 11 bye, Adam Schefter reports that Hurts is considered sidelined indefinitely. The move is in response to the blood clot which has become an increasing concern for both Hurts and the Eagles. The blood clot was originally caused when he was cleated earlier in the season and he played through the injury in the Eagles’ Week 5 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars . However, tests have since shown that the clot has moved, sparking significant concern. ESPN is reporting that Hurts could be treated with blood thinners, and the average treatment course being six weeks. However, it’s possible that he could be sidelined for as long as three months, which would effectively be season-ending. The Eagles are tied with the Dallas Cowboys at 2-3 on the season, and 1.5 games behind the first place Giants. Philly’s seaso…

stories.title: Knicks waive Bruce Brown, expected to sign James Wiseman for final roster spot
stories.summary: The Knicks announced they have waived Bruce Brown, with center James Wiseman expected to capture the team's final roster spot ahead of the season opener.
stories.detail: The Knicks were unable to finalize a trade to make room on the roster and were forced to waive guard Bruce Brown ahead of the regular season, the team announced Saturday. New York liked Brown, who survived preseason cuts following Thursday's preseason finale, but it needed to trade a player on a standard contract to remain below the second apron if it wanted to keep both Brown and James Wiseman -- the final roster spot selection. Unfortunately, the Knicks couldn't find a trade partner. It wasn't for a lack of trying, though. SNY's Ian Begley reported earlier in the week that New York would "explore all avenues" to keep Brown and Wiseman and mentioned that it was "logical to assume" that Pacome Dadiet would be a player the Knicks would try to move. Tyler Kolek 's name was also mentioned as a possible trade candidate. Since New York couldn't send any money in a deal, it needed to include draft picks (the Knicks have 11 second-round picks over the next seven drafts). But even that substantial capital wasn't enough to make a trade, which meant New York had to say goodbye to Brown. In theory, the Knicks could still make a trade after the first game and then bring Brown back. But for th…
